title: Add generated rules-pack character resolver and remove SRD_CATALOG usage
description:
Migrate character creation validation off the legacy hand-authored SRD_CATALOG and onto the runtime generated rules pack. This covers the core of eshyra-x50w but should be shaped as the resolver seam needed by the guided character creation architecture.

Implementation direction
- Add a RulesPackCharacterResolver over getBundledDnd5eSrdPack / lookupRulesRecord or the current generated-pack runtime API.
- Resolve classes, spells, ancestries, backgrounds, and equipment by generated record data where available.
- Centralize display-name/common-alias matching so users do not need internal record IDs.
- Add typed guards/narrowing around generated data:unknown, especially class hitDie and spell classes/level.
- Migrate existing character creation class/spell/HP validation to the resolver.
- Remove imports from packages/core/src/rules/srd/ in character creation code.
- Once nothing depends on it, delete the legacy SRD catalog files and internal exports.

Acceptance criteria
- Character creation no longer imports SRD_CATALOG, lookupSrdRecord, or legacy Srd* types.
- Existing class and spell validation behavior is preserved or improved using generated records.
- Class hit die used for HP comes from generated class data.
- Spell availability comes from generated spell data.
- Legacy SRD catalog files and tests are deleted or replaced once unused.
- rules/README.md no longer documents the legacy catalog as active runtime truth.
notes: PR #283 (feat/b69j-rules-pack-resolver) open for review. RulesPackCharacterResolver added; SRD_CATALOG retired; all gates green. Awaiting merge.
